hero.title: Graph-Powered Conversational AI
hero.subtitle: Design, visualize, and run complex AI workflows on an interactive canvas. Build branching conversations, orchestrate multi-step reasoning, and interact through a polished chat experience.

header.title: Why Linear Chat Falls Short
header.subtitle: Your thinking isn't a straight line—it branches, explores, and iterates. Traditional AI chat forces you into a single thread, losing context and clarity.

messages.user1: My API endpoint is too slow. How can I optimize it?
messages.ai1: You could optimize the database query by adding an index...
messages.frustration1: Wait, what if caching is better? You scroll up to reconsider...
messages.user2: Actually, could we try a caching strategy instead?
messages.ai2: Sure, here's how to implement Redis caching...
messages.frustration2: Now you have two competing solutions in one messy thread.
messages.user3: What about async processing? And can you show me the database query again?
messages.frustration3: Context lost. You're copy-pasting and starting over.

header.subtitle: Meridian transforms AI interaction into a visual graph. Connect nodes to build powerful workflows that preserve the rich context and relationships between ideas, unlocking capabilities linear chats can't match.

visual.title: Visual-First Design
visual.text: See your entire AI workflow at a glance. No more hidden context or mysterious jumps between topics.

context.title: True Context Management
context.text: Branch conversations naturally, merge insights from multiple sources, and maintain precise control over what information flows where.

orchestration.title: Model Orchestration
orchestration.text: Route queries to specialized models, run parallel comparisons, and synthesize results automatically.

developer.title: Developer-Native
developer.text: Deep GitHub integration, syntax highlighting for 220+ languages, and LaTeX support built-in.
